jobs.description_text: SENIOR INFORMATION SYSTEM SECURITY OFFICER (ISSO) Based onsite at Rocket Lab's global headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the Information System Security Officer (ISSO) is responsible for maintaining the overall security posture for all Rocket Lab classified information systems and is accountable for the implementation of the Risk Management Framework (RMF). The ISSO will be responsible for implementing and maintaining security controls for systems, ensuring ongoing Authorization to Operate (ATO), and serving as a security advisor to system owners and development teams. jobs.description_text: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a Director, Retail Solutions & Product Management to lead the strategy, development, and business performance of our growing ELERA retail solutions portfolio. This portfolio includes enterprise retail software, Loss Prevention, Produce Recognition, video and computer vision solutions, vision analytics, and emerging AI-enabled retail and store-operations capabilities. You will be responsible for parts of that solutions portfolio. ELERA serves many of the world's top global retailers, along with hundreds of customers across grocery, hospitality, convenience, and specialty markets. This leader will shape the future of our retail solutions by translating customer needs, market opportunities, and emerging technologies into differentiated products that deliver measurable business value. This is a senior product and business leadership position with ownership of portfolio strategy, financial performance, investment decisions, roadmap commitments, commercialization, and product lifecycle management. The Director will lead and develop an experienced product management organization, establish clear priorities across competing business demands, and build strong partnerships with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, Customer Success, Finance, and strategic partners.
